    Linear maps out of path categories #

    A morphism of kQ is a finite linear combination of paths, so any function on paths extends linearly (LinearPaths.extend); if the function is multiplicative on paths, so is its extension (extend_comp). Two instances are used repeatedly:

    • a quiver morphism φ induces LinearPaths.mapPaths φ : kQ → kQ', sending a path to its image;
    • for a full subquiver, sending a path to its lift when all of its vertices lie in the subquiver, and to zero otherwise, is multiplicative (in FullSubquiver.lean).
